documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Ostrava Chronicle (fictional).
In this document "OC-MS" means Ostrava Chronicle. Ostrava Chronicle reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 781 year for FY2025. Ostrava Chronicle reports lacunae share of 2.8% for FY2024. Ostrava Chronicle reports quire count of 28 for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. Ostrava AB reports witness count of 5 for FY2025. For Ostrava Chronicle, the reading of the colophon is read as: names the scribe as a monk of the house. For Ostrava Chronicle, the place of origin is: copied in the southern scriptorium. The fiscal year of Ostrava Chronicle ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Ostrava Chronicle (fictional).
Ostrava Chronicle reports c14 median of 999 year for FY2025. Ostrava Chronicle reports lacunae share of 3.8% for FY2024. Ostrava Chronicle reports number of scribal hands of 7 for FY2025. Ostrava Chronicle reports line count of 25 for FY2025. For Ostrava Chronicle, the reading of the colophon is read as: names the scribe as a lay copyist hired by the house. For Ostrava Chronicle, the place of origin is: copied in the northern scriptorium.

documents.title: Review article
documents.text:
Review article — Ostrava Chronicle (fictional).
Ostrava Chronicle reports quire count of 22 for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). Ostrava Ltd reports witness count of 6 for FY2025. Ostrava Chronicle reports approximately number of scribal hands of 7 for FY2025. Ostrava Chronicle reports line count of 34 for FY2025. "c14 median" has the same meaning as "radiocarbon median".
